keyDecisions.decision: Keep seven main presentation frames and separate appendices; treat interactive HTML as supporting artifact pending current-form confirmation.
Do not certify MOD13Q1 or engineering documents as qualifying challenge Resources until official inclusion is established.
Use Mars image only as explicitly labeled proposed expansion with no integration into the current engine.
Use five evaluation dimensions as editorial prompts, without inventing central scoring weights or a local pitch time.
